description: Use this when you want to know which AI crawlers a website bans. The Bouncer reads the domain robots.txt and returns a verdict per crawler (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot and 18 more) plus a shareable page. Fetches one public file, cached a day. Read only.

domain.description: A public domain like nytimes.com. No ports, no IP addresses.

name: check_the_door

outputSchema.description: The same JSON the HTTP door returns. Read content[0].text for the line to say to your human.
